text:
maya: Starting blue->green for router-main: v2.7.1 -> v2.8.0. Change window 45m. Plan: cohorted EU roll: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 5m hold between steps. Watchers: @sre-oncall. Release notes: https://redwood/release/rv2.8.0 (note session fix).
chad: quick preflight: did we pin kafka consumer offsets on green? last time we saw dupes.
infra-bot: prereq ok: green nodes drained, healthchecks ok, cache primed, consumer-offset-locks present.
deploy-bot: deployment initiated by maya. session=wr-20260321-2. step=1 weight=10% green -> ts=1712104595
sasha: running EU probe script from three AZs. will post every 3m.
chad: also set connection-drain to 10s for green to avoid long-lived conn impact.
maya: good call. drain set: `lbctl set-drain --pool green --timeout 10s`
sre-oncall: watching p50/p95 and 4xx rate. alert thresholds: p95>400ms OR 4xx>0.4% for 3m.
deploy-bot: step=2 weight=30% green -> ts=1712104710
sasha: probe eu-west1: 30% green p95=220ms p50=60ms 4xx=0.12%
chad: noticing slightly more cookie churn on green in eu-west1. not a lot yet.
maya: pause at 30%. don't advance until we confirm cookie header parity.
deploy-bot: ramp paused by maya -> pinned weight=30%
infra-bot: temp command available: `routectl cohort-pin --route router-main --cohort eu --weight green=30`
sasha: digging: Set-Cookie path and SameSite differ on green for a subset of responses. suspect middleware change.
chad: can we pin session-affinity on cookie name to blue for EU while patching?
maya: yes, do that. chad take action.
chad: applied `routectl affinity --route router-main --cohort eu --cookie-name session_id --pin blue`. verifying...
sasha: after pin: probes show p95 back to 160ms, 4xx=0.09%
sre-oncall: good. recommend warmup at 50% for 10m before global ramp.
maya: agreed. increase EU to 50% for 10m.
deploy-bot: step=resume eu weight=50% -> ts=1712104810
sasha: warmup checks at +6m: p95=170ms, 4xx=0.11% across AZs. no error spikes.
maya: hotfix PR ready to flip SameSite/path. once green image with fix lands, we'll remove affinity pin and continue. can we push image to staging+green?
deploy-bot: green image updated to v2.8.0+cookiefix. redeploy started -> ts=1712104885
infra-bot: note: recorded rollback playbook ROLL-4720 and tagged registry v2.7.1 as fallback. DNS TTL note: edge DNS ttl=30s, could cause residual clients to blue.
chad: post-deploy probe: eu p95=130ms, 4xx=0.04% (good). removing cookie pin in 2m.
maya: once pin removed, run 10m observation at 75% EU then global gradual shift to 100% over 12m.
deploy-bot: removing pin per chad -> `affinity remove` executed -> ts=1712104915
sre-oncall: monitoring. if 4xx > 0.5% or p95>350ms for 3m -> auto-roll to v2.7.1.
sasha: +5m checks clean. recommend proceed to global 100%.
maya: okay go for global final ramp. command: `routectl gradual-shift --route router-main --target green=100 --duration 12m`
deploy-bot: final ramp started -> expected_complete=1712105643
infra-bot: kept a temp holdback rule for APAC to avoid cross-region DNS cache issues. will release after 30m.
chad: updated release notes with cookie fix and drain timeout change.
maya: thanks team. will close thread when deploy-bot publishes completion.
deploy-bot: traffic shift complete. outcome=success, final_version=v2.8.0, rollback_triggered=false, notes="affinity pin used during hotfix; DNS TTL and drain considered" -> ts=1712104923
